trigger.about: computes ANOVA power with scipy.stats.ncf.sf (or a frozen ncf(...).sf), which returns -cdf instead of 1-cdf when the noncentrality is 0

summary: scipy.stats.ncf.sf(x, dfn, dfd, nc=0) returns -ncf.cdf(x) (a negative probability) instead of 1 - cdf, so power at effect size 0 comes out as about -0.95 instead of alpha
